<!-- pr-reviewer: 4c0f3e826c5f46692fa2d57c9eea4067be5fd774 -->
**Needs changes before merge** (one small law item; the code itself looks sound).

## What looks good
- The merge keeps what main shipped. `dispatch_align` now also routes `AlignPartCylinder` (new `Draft::Cylinder`, picks stay disarmed as before), `PlaceSetupOrigin` stays in `state.rs`, and `lay_on_plane_in` / `lay_on_points_in` are re-exported. Main's relative row, the WCS group (Pick for WCS, #1571) and the commands behind the #1466 re-apply and #1518 WCS tilt refusals are untouched, and the "Manual" method draws main's #738 preset / Turn by picker unchanged.
- `align_from_cylinder` does read the held alignment (`axis_through(world, held.rot, ..)`, `compose(turn, held)`), so it composes like #738. It then proves the landing (`LAND_TOL`) and refuses by name otherwise. A wrongly oriented part cannot result silently: the landed axis is exact and the new alignment is shown in the status line. The PR body's "absolute part frame" note is too cautious. What is not relative to the held pose is the spin about the target axis: it is the typed angle from a fill axis chosen by the pick, not an increment on the current spin. That is visible in the status line, so I do not count it a blocker.
- No `unwrap` / `expect` / `panic!` in the new files. No snapshot PNG touched. Apply goes through undoable commands; new files are under 400 lines; the decision file is present.
- The edited tests are not weakened. Every row that was asserted still is, now behind its method (`plane_method` switches the dropdown first), with added `gone(...)` checks and Apply counts per method.

## Results merged with main (locally, main at ce814fe5b; no Actions run: outside-contributor code)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `camcraft-app` tests `orient_dropdowns` / `align_compose` / `align_axes` | 9 / 3 / 9 passed |
| `camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`) | 741 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| clippy `-D warnings`, `camcraft-ui` + `camcraft-app` `--all-targets` | clean |

The edited ui tests all live in the lib, so no separate ui integration binary was owed.

## Requested before merge
1. **MCP tool owed for the two new commands.** `CommandKind::AlignPartCylinder` and `CommandKind::PlaceSetupOrigin` have no tool in `crates/app/src/mcp/` (`align_tools.rs` covers only the axes verb), and neither the PR body nor `docs/decisions/771-orient-dropdowns.md` names a follow-up. AGENTS.md "Commands ship with an MCP tool": add the tools, or file `MCP: align part from cylinder` and `MCP: place setup origin` (`source:agent`, `P5`, `area:mcp`) and name them in the PR body.

## Notes (not blocking)
- Owed: before/after screenshots (maintainer: "Merge without screenshots").
- With Axes as the default method, the stored-alignment readout and the "As modelled" reset sit only under Manual (`setup_align_pick::picker`). A user on Axes cannot see the held alignment text or reset from there. Worth a follow-up if that matters.
- `setup_orient_pick.rs:9-12` still says the section is mounted on "the Setups overview"; it is mounted on each setup's Settings page only now.
- The pixel snapshots (release lane), the GUI and Windows-only readings were not exercised.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 4c0f3e826c5f46692fa2d57c9eea4067be5fd774 -->
The one requested change (MCP tools for AlignPartCylinder and PlaceSetupOrigin) is resolved by follow-up issue #1586, which exists (P5, area:mcp) and is now named in the PR body. Head is unchanged. The earlier review otherwise stands: tests and clippy were clean, and screenshots are owed, not blocking.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
